description: This file defines express routes for analytics overview in a Node.js backend, including HTTP handlers for GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests on the '/overview' endpoint, which responds with overview metrics for a dashboard.

methods.name: router.head
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests to '/overview', returning headers indicating the endpoint and cache control, with a 204 status.

methods.name: router.options
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests to '/overview', returning a 204 status.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/overview', invoking the imported 'overviewMetrics' controller method to return dashboard metrics.
